# Three.js runtime

Official npm package `three@0.186.1`, downloaded from `https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.186.1.tgz` and checked against registry SHA-512 integrity `blFeqb49wRCSGUGj7gtpfnSGHy2lwDk94RhUmS1c/hTby70kvChbWpkJ4Pm1390LqzzvTmzgXKHPEafJwCb8jA==`.

The official core/WebGL module is bundled and minified as an ES module using esbuild 0.25.12. `three-LICENSE.txt` preserves its MIT license. No Wawa/Studio375 code or art is included; those sources informed the physical-book research.
